description: Redesign the Formula Center UI to be highly navigatable with tabbed subject navigation, expandable formula cards grouped by topic, a Quick Reference section for high-frequency formulas, and improved search/filter. This depends on FEAT-001 being complete (expanded formula data and metadata).
steps: Refactor src/features/formulas/components/formula-center.tsx into a more navigatable layout: (1) Subject tabs as a horizontal scrollable tab bar at the top (using subject abbreviations and formula counts), (2) When a subject is selected, show formulas grouped by topic (using the new topic field), (3) Each topic group has a collapsible header showing topic name and formula count, (4) Formula cards are expandable (click to reveal variables, example, keyTip).

Add a 'Quick Reference' view mode (toggle button at top) that shows only formulas with examFrequency === 'high' across all subjects, grouped by subject. This gives users fast access to the most important formulas.
Add exam frequency badges to formula cards (small colored indicator: green for high, gold for medium, gray for low frequency).
Add a 'Bookmarked' filter tab alongside subjects that shows only bookmarked formulas.
Keep the existing search functionality but make it search across name, formula text, variables, and topic fields.

Ensure the component follows existing React patterns: useState(() => ...) for localStorage reads, no useSyncExternalStore, inline styles with CSS variables (--accent-primary: #002B5C, --accent-secondary: #C5A258, --accent-success: #00843D, --card-bg, --card-border, --foreground, --foreground-secondary).
Update src/app/(protected)/formulas/page.tsx if needed to pass any props or adjust the page header.
Create or update any necessary barrel exports.
acceptance_criteria: Formula center displays subject tabs with formula count per subject
Selecting a subject shows formulas grouped by topic within that subject
Formula cards expand on click to show variables, example, and key tip
Quick Reference toggle shows only high-frequency formulas
Bookmarked tab shows only user-bookmarked formulas
Search works across name, formula, variables, and topic
Exam frequency badges display on formula cards
localStorage reads use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer pattern
bun run tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
